name: Debts
overview: Scripture teaches that owing debts places a person in a position of servitude to the lender, urging believers to avoid becoming sureties for others' debts and to be cautious in financial commitments. Christians are called to fulfill their obligations responsibly, rendering what is due to others, but ultimately to owe nothing except love, which fulfills the law. God promises to provide for the needs of His people, encouraging trust in His provision rather than reliance on indebtedness.
